name: SLOWER TRAFFIC KEEP RIGHT
spec: white vertical rectangle with black legend SLOWER TRAFFIC KEEP RIGHT
meaning: If you are driving slower than others, use the right lane.

snippets.back: In slow traffic, shifting to neutral and briefly racing the engine during stops helps prevent overheating; if steam appears, pull over, shut off the engine and do not open the radiator cap.
When approaching unusually slow traffic, leave time to slow down or change lanes without sudden braking.

Expect sluggish trucks and tractors on grades, yield to signaling buses, grant orange triangle rigs under twenty five miles per hour room, and pass slow traffic lawfully even over double yellow with clear sight.
Adapt pace early to slow traffic with lane moves or gentle braking, never sudden stomps.
The keep-far-right rule has an exception on a highway with more than two lanes when the right lane is designated for slow traffic.
At a lane reduction, merge early if traffic is light; in dense slow traffic use both lanes to the merge point and alternate joining there.
On a multilane highway, Slower Traffic Keep Right directs vehicles below the normal traffic speed into the right lane.

Cyclists yield crosswalks and sidewalks to walkers with a bell or horn warning, light white front and red rear at night, hug the right edge as slow traffic with extreme care when centering for debris, passes, or lefts, never ride sidewalks, never block walkers with parked bikes, and take adjacent paths when built.
